allowedSourceMaterial.overview: Mulder and Scully, now taken off the FBI's X Files cases, must find a way to fight the shadowy elements of the government to find out the truth about a conspiracy that might mean the alien colonization of Earth.

facts.overview: Mulder and Scully, now taken off the FBI's X Files cases, must find a way to fight the shadowy elements of the government to find out the truth about a conspiracy that might mean the alien colonization of Earth.
facts.title: The X-Files

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: With their official backing severed, how do two sidelined agents expose a hidden faction before an extraterrestrial takeover becomes inevitable?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: After being pulled off the FBI's X Files unit, Mulder and Scully confront shadowy government forces while tracking a clandestine plot that points toward the alien colonization of Earth.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: A steady, suspenseful sci-fi thriller driven by conspiratorial tension, rewarding engaged and solitary late-night viewing.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Director Rob Bowman expands the investigation to a cinematic canvas, delivering a tense, plot-driven mystery where institutional secrecy clashes with existential discovery.
